responsibility: This generated scheduling description defines the DFA pipeline reservations and latencies for C6X instructions after expansion of side- and cross-path-specific variants. It maps instruction attributes such as type, unit class, destination register file, and cross usage onto concrete reservations for the D/L/S/M units, branch resources, cross paths, and timing, providing the automaton data consumed by GCC’s instruction scheduler and the backend’s exposed-pipeline scheduling hooks.
